# aicupa (TodoList Pro)
> AI-powered cross-platform task management system app.

This is the main entry point for aicupa (TodoList Pro), a developer-centric task management solution designed to streamline workflows, manage multi-tasking bottlenecks, and synchronize seamlessly with VS Code.

## Developer & Technical Resources
- [Complete Documentation](https://docs.aicupa.com/llms.txt): The comprehensive developer guides, API references, and architecture maps (LLM-friendly format).
- [Documentation Home](https://docs.aicupa.com/): The human-readable user guides and configuration manuals for the TodoList Pro ecosystem.

## Extension Marketplaces
- [VS Code Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=saber2pr.todolist): Direct link to install the TodoList Pro extension for official VS Code environments.
- [Open VSX Registry](https://open-vsx.org/extension/saber2pr/todolist): Open-source extension registry alternative for VSCodium and other compliant IDEs.

## Features & Capabilities
- **Local-first Architecture**: Built for privacy and speed, utilizing local storage with seamless cross-platform syncing capabilities.
- **Context Management**: Specifically designed to help developers manage context switching when temporary tasks interrupt mainline development.
- **SaaS Layout**: High-density, minimalist, and dark-mode first UI tailored for software engineers.
